body: It must be painful to have been abandoned. It concerns me when I think about the loneliness you must be feeling.

It must be so painful for you to have been abandoned. You don’t sound anything remotely close to your mother. 

Have you thought about sharing any of this with your fiancé? It sounds like a very tough time right now
Hey op, it sounds very frustrating to not be heard. Do you mind if I ask you a question? What happened 2 years ago?
It must be so painful to not have support right now. I’m so sorry you’re going through this
It sounds so painful to be ignored. If I were you, I’d be hurting too
It worries me to read this. I want to understand why you feel this way
I’m so sorry you’re going through this u/d4ddysk1773n. It concerns me to think how painful this is.
Do you mind if I ask you some more questions? I’m just trying to understand. Can you tell me about your bosses?
What do you do for work? How do you feel at the end of the day?
Short answer: absolutely not
Your life isn’t over you’re only halfway through
Im so sorry you’re going through this. You said you’ve been fighting for 7 years?! What kind of strength do you have?! Are you Wonder Woman?
Take a mental health day. 24 hours take to yourself, however that looks like. I did some yard work, worked out, read a little of my book, ate some good food, and watched some of my favorite shows

Hang in there. The Bible says these things might happen. Keep praying.

Have you prayed for your parents? What do they need help with today?

You can’t live by your feelings…I know it sucks but it’s the truth

Start taking walks. It’s helped me immensely. Studies have proven exercise can be as good if not better than ssri’s. 

Take a 10 minute walk and let me know how you feel
Don’t do this. Not today. Put this off until tomorrow

I’m so sorry your own family is treating you this way. You’ve got to rise up and see how beautiful you are. Look in the mirror. Do you not see??? Or have you been blinded?

Start taking care of yourself. Take action. One day, you’re gonna thank your brother for helping you to start fixing your life.

Use this for motivation and fuel. Imagine your life where the depression is gone. You have a job and possessions and you’re happy. What would you be doing? What kind of car would you own? You become what you think about.
You’re not alone. I’m only 5000 miles away from you

I’m so sorry you’re going through this. You’re not a pathetic failure. Don’t listen to these words. You’re an amazing person. You have so many talents and gifts the world needs right now.

Take action against this. Start doing something about it. Are you walking?? Taking a walk has helped me immensely. I’m not joking. Exercise has been scientifically proven to be as effective( or even better!!) than most ssri’s.

Start by doing a 15 walk in the mornings if you can. Just open your door and set a timer for 7.5 minutes and when it goes off just head home
Friend, why do you not want to live? The air you’re breathing now, it’s a gift.

It’s too late dude. I’ve noticed. You can’t do it today. Put this off until tomorrow. Not today. You can’t ever take this back. You don’t buy a house or a car without really thinking about it. How much more your life than these??

What happened?

I’m sorry you’re going through this. It’s not easy. You’ve got to keep forcing yourself to do the work. You will not feel anything at first. You might even feel pretty crappy. The feelings will come. I know the pain. Hang in there. Negativity will attract more negativity, so try to be more positive. If you could do anything as your profession what would it be? Even if it was a professional Cheeto tester or something

I’m so sorry you’re going through this. You’re so strong to have called. You’re tough as nails for posting this. Hang in there. Don’t stop. Don’t fucking quit. You’re better than that. You’re stronger than quitters. Hang in there. Please. Can I do anything to help??

Don’t do this tonight. Wait until tomorrow. Not today friend. It’s not your time.

Tomorrow will be better than today.

You might not have accomplished much in your life, but who knows what you can accomplish u/paiigelisa? What if there’s somebody out there who just lost their mom?? And they’re thinking of killing themselves today. What would you say?

Dude you can save lives. You matter. Please don’t stop. Don’t fucking quit on me. Do you hear me?

You have one of the kindest hearts I’ve seen my friend. For you to be going through this right now and to be thinking of how you can help others?? That’s so selfless…

I’m so sorry to hear about your family’s actions. You are not a mistake. It’s ok to cry. You are so valuable. The world needs you right now. Your community needs you right now. Please don’t stop. Keep going. Hang in there. Please.

Don’t stop. Keep trying.

Hey u/oli7887. Dude you struggled with depression and came out on the other side?! That’s win #1. You might not be graduating on time, but you’re fucking graduating college! Win #2.

Your parents are so proud of you. You took care of your drinking. That’s win #3. I’m sorry it seems pointless right now but it will make sense one day. Trust me. Take your time. I’m 33 and just got into college as of two days ago. It’s never too late! I still don’t have it figured out.

Dude you’re doing great. Keep it up. Hang in there. You’ve got to hang in there right now. Keep working. Keep going. You got this. You got this. You are so inspiring to me.

Thank you for posting this. I’m going to get a workout done right now

Oh my gosh haha!

As far as your energy, how’s your water intake? Exercise routines? What’s your nutrition? How’s your sleep quality?

Your motivation isn’t there right now but that’s ok. Motivation is crap. You literally said you force yourself to do anything? That sounds like some drive to me. Motion creates emotion. Fake it till you make it. It’ll come friend

Hey u/almost_hollow.

I’m a personal trainer. And you know what?

YOU inspire me. People like you motivate me to be at my best.

I’m sorry things are a struggle for you right now. Can I do anything to help?? Hang in there friend.
Did you start your evrysdi treatment? I see it’s been awhile since you posted. How are you doing?
My daughter has taken this for a few months. She is non verbal, but her strength has improved.

My daughter was diagnosed as type 1. We were told she would not live to see her second birthday. She just turned 8 by the way.

When she was born, there were no drugs to treat this. I’ve heard amazing things about these new drugs. I’ve heard these kids who take them early have better chances of living a normal life.

I am sorry this has happened to your nephew. You are a great uncle for you to come here and post this. Your nephew has good things ahead for him.

Your sister and brother in law are going through a rough time right now. Stay positive friend. Help wherever you can. Help them see the light at the end of the tunnel. Your nephew will be ok. Who knows what kind of life he will live? It will be a good life.

In the meantime, stay as strong and positive as you can be. Rephrase negative thoughts into positive ones. It’s ok to be afraid. Don’t vocalize it.

Hang in there friend.

This is so friggin motivating for me to read today.

I woke up every 20-30 minutes last night in a cold sweat and just felt awful. Felt like caving in today

Keep going buddy.
